graph_coordinates.scaffold: achiral Bemis-Murcko scaffold SMILES, with acyclic molecules assigned an explicit sentinel
graph_coordinates.ring_system: canonical SMILES for each connected component of rings sharing at least one atom
graph_coordinates.route: ordered reaction-name sequence, reaction-family support, and reaction depth
graph_coordinates.molecular_graph: heavy atoms, bonds, rings, hetero atoms, and connectivity summaries
graph_coordinates.representation: terminal-molecule state embedding from the frozen RxnFlow GINE encoder before condition concatenation
graph_coordinates.representation_preprocessing: center on the eligible construction view, deterministic full SVD, retain at most 32 nonzero components, divide by singular-value scale, then L2-normalize

development_banks.eligible_pool: unique canonical products with successful selected-target reward and finite graph coordinates in the construction view
development_banks.duplicate_rule: retain the lowest record-identity hash for each canonical product
development_banks.hash_uniform: select the 512 lowest SHA-256 values of development-hash-v1|record_id
development_banks.reward_signal: rank by target reward descending, limit each scaffold to eight records and each exact route signature to 64 records, then fill any remainder in reward order
development_banks.validity_cost: rank eligible records by generated-action count, oracle wall time, and record hash in ascending order
development_banks.scaffold_coverage: greedily maximize new Bemis-Murcko scaffolds and ring-system signatures, then scaffold rarity, with record hash as the final tie-breaker
development_banks.route_coverage: greedily maximize reaction-family and reaction-depth coverage using inverse eligible-pool frequency, with record hash as the final tie-breaker
development_banks.graph_embedding_coverage: greedy farthest-first traversal in the frozen normalized representation, initialized by the record nearest the eligible-pool centroid and tied by record hash

confirmation.confirmation_view_role: repeat the measurements and independently reconstruct development-bank summaries without contributing members
confirmation.failure_action: abstain before candidate freeze or version a new protocol
